title: Automated Machine-Learning Framework Integrating Histopathological and Radiological Information for Predicting IDH1 Mutation Status in Glioma
summary: Full Frontiers article reports an automated ML framework combining histopathology and radiology to predict glioma IDH1 status. This is retrospective diagnostic prediction, not a new biological mechanism.
